operative_text.controlling:
2.20(1)  If as a result of an action a litigation representative
receives money, other than under a costs award, that money must
be paid into Court unless the Court otherwise orders or an
enactment or instrument otherwise provides.
(2)  A payment made to a litigation representative on account of
money due to a party represented by the litigation representative,
other than under a costs award, is not a valid discharge as against
that party unless otherwise provided by an instrument, order or
enactment.
